text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
Speak to the sons of Israel! And take to me first-fruits of all the things which seem good; in the heart! You shall take the first-fruits of mine.
And this is the first-fruit which you shall take of them -- gold, silver, brass,
blue, purple, scarlet doubled up, and linen being twined, and hairs of goats,

And you shall make for me a sanctuary, and I will be seen by you.
And you shall make for me according to all as much as I show you in the mountain -- the model of the tent, and the model of all the items of it -- even so shall you do.
